name: 20 — Performance: 50 Users (WITH Temporal)
description: Performance test with 50 concurrent users, 3 messages each (150 total requests). Client has app assigned → triggers Temporal AppFlow workflows. Tests worker capacity: 4 workers × 25 concurrency = 100 slots. Expected: 100% pass with 5-6s latency (vs 300ms direct). Verifies Temporal integration works under load.
